mentions.name: hugind
mentions.description: Hugind is a daemon for running LLM inference reliably on company hardware, even when the hardware is poor or outdated, with the goal of bringing chaotic agentic behavior under control in business contexts.
mentions.problem: LLM inference is unreliable on poor or outdated company hardware, and agentic behavior can be chaotic in business contexts.
mentions.audience: Companies and teams running LLM workloads on poor or outdated company hardware in business contexts
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am working on hugind, I have two goals:

- make it reliable to run LLM inference on company hardware, even when it is poor or outdated

- bring chaotic agentic behavior under control in business contexts
